---
title: "Build Model Data"
params:
  bootstrap_rep: 3
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: timestamp-start
#| echo: false

timestamp()
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
source(here("utils","check_packages.R"))
source(here("utils","functions.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| include: false

load(here("data", "data_constructed", "individ_data.RData"))

# relevel year and factor up anything that might go into models
census <- census |>
  mutate(year = factor(year),
         year = relevel(year, "2000"),
         region = factor(region),
         division = factor(division),
         state = factor(state)) |>
  filter(gen_husband == "2nd+" & gen_wife == "2nd+")
```

```{r}
#| label: generate-state-model-data

data_model_state <- census |>
  generate_bootstrap_data(params$bootstrap_rep, composition_var = "state")
```

```{r}
#| label: generate-state-region-model-data

data_model_state_region <- census |>
  generate_bootstrap_data(params$bootstrap_rep,
                          composition_var = "state",
                          conditional_var = "region")
```

```{r}
#| label: generate-best-race-model-data

transform_race <- function(race, subrace, best_race) {
  
  race <- as.character(race)
  race <- case_when(
    subrace == "PI" ~ "API",
    race == "Asian" ~ "API",
    race == "Indigenous" ~ "AIAN",
    TRUE ~ race
  )
  
  race <- if_else(!is.na(best_race), best_race, race)
  race <- factor(race, levels = c("White", "Black", "AIAN", "API", "Hispanic"))
  return(race)
}

data_model_best_race_state <- census |>
  mutate(race_husband = transform_race(race_husband, subrace_husband, race_best_husband),
         race_wife = transform_race(race_wife, subrace_wife, race_best_wife)) |>
  generate_bootstrap_data(params$bootstrap_rep, composition_var = "state")
```

```{r}
#| label: save-data

save(data_model_state, 
     file = here("data", "data_constructed", "model_data.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: timestamp-end
#| echo: false

timestamp()
```
